name: CosVoice
description: Provisions a dedicated US phone number and email address for an AI agent over MCP: place and answer calls, send texts and email, book by phone, and get a transcript and summary of each call.

skills.name: Phone Line Provisioning
skills.description: Search available US numbers and provision a dedicated line for an agent via search_numbers, create_line, and get_line.

skills.name: Place and Track Calls
skills.description: Place calls with place_call, then retrieve records, transcripts, and summaries through get_call, list_calls, and annotate_call.

skills.name: Phone Reservations
skills.description: Book reservations over the phone with book_reservation and review existing ones with list_reservations.

skills.name: Text Messaging
skills.description: Send SMS with send_text and read inbound and outbound messages on the line with list_messages.

skills.name: Email Handling
skills.description: Send, read, and forward mail for the agent's address via send_email, list_emails, get_email, and forward_email.

skills.name: Contact Management
skills.description: Maintain the line's address book using list_contacts, add_contact, and remove_contact.

skills.name: Event Notifications
skills.description: Register callbacks with set_webhook and set_bot_push, and review past events through list_history and recent_activity.
